findings.text: non-blocking: the committed-tree location check resolves committed_run_review_directory from the run id handed to --run alone, so a record committed under the reviewed run's directory is still refused when --run names the review run, against the docstring at line 3485 claiming either run's directory is accepted.

non-blocking: the repair accepts any id that extends the stored value, not only the review run's own id as the deliverable states, so a typo repaired to a wrong longer id is refused only later by crew check --review --run.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base bc6d7fd9; one commit changes repair_run_review in reckon/crew/review.py and the check command in reckon/crew_run_commands.py, and adds the test and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's four cases are among the five cases in tests/test_a_mistyped_review_run_id_can_be_repaired.py and the head arm records 56 passed at e8bd52d044; the base arm ran only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, which imports neither changed module, so the done-when's "test files importing the changed modules add no failure against the base revision" is not measured, as the manifest's blockers record.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a mistyped review run id is refused at write time and repairable; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:crew_check sets expected_run_id for a review-role run and refuses a record whose id is not that run's own, and reckon/crew/review.py:repair_run_review now rewrites review_run_id only to a longer id.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the head arm 56 passed, the negative control 1 failed and 4 passed, tests/test_review_record_contract.py 62 passed, and names its logs; it discloses the cancelled importer-population arm under blockers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, the new test and the evidence fragment; git show e8bd52d044 --numstat lists exactly those four files plus nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_mistyped_review_run_id_can_be_repaired.py:101 fails when the prefix rule is removed, as negative-control.log records, and its assertion names the fixture's own full id rather than a value read back from the code.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-arm.log shows 56 passed and negative-control.log shows the repair case red, but gate-base-arm.log measures tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, which imports neither changed module.
justifications.fit: the helpers are imported from reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py in the same private-name style crew_run_*commands*.py:3462 already uses, and the new comments state the mechanism rather than a ticket.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1307 sets expected_run_id only for a review-role pointer and the refusal names the full id, while reckon/crew/review.py:3572 accepts any extension of the stored id rather than only the review run's own.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1300 reuses _declared_head_keyed_record, _is_review_run and stored_record, and a search of reckon/ for a run-id prefix rule found no owner to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: all four paths in git show e8bd52d044 --numstat sit inside the manifest's declared write paths, with no plan or state edit.
